money.description: Monthly dollar amount, number (e.g. 2450.5). No currency symbol, no commas.

name.description: Participant name, exactly as in the participant data

ssn.description: SSN exactly as in the participant data (e.g. 123-45-6789). Never invent or complete a masked SSN.

description: Input for the Estimated Benefits Adjustment Analysis memo. Template: Estimated Benefits Adjustment Analysis Memo - Updates 2024, version of 11/25/2024. Synthetic data only.

bpd.description: Bankruptcy Petition Date, YYYY-MM-DD or null

caseNumber.description: PBGC case number, text, leading zeros kept

ccSupervisor.description: CC — Benefits Specialist Supervisor, CSD Branch 2A

dotr.description: Date of Trusteeship, YYYY-MM-DD or null

fromSection.description: FROM — ASD section code, e.g. D (app renders ASD/D)

facts.description: Facts and circumstances, with event dates (STE 100 minimal)

q1.description: Did the plan sponsor file for bankruptcy on or after 09/16/2006?

q2.description: Did the plan terminate while the company was in bankruptcy?

answer.description: Does the plan provide UCEBs due to an event on or after 07/27/2005?

eventDates.description: Date(s) of the event(s) (required if yes)

ipsNumber.description: §436 Evaluation IPS number (required unless outcome is 3.1)

limitations.description: Which §436 limitations applied (required if outcome is 3.4)

outcome.description: 3.1 DOPT before FD-PY2008; 3.2 no benefits potentially subject; 3.3 none applicable; 3.4 limitations applicable

forms.description: Non-level benefit forms the plan provides (required if q1 is yes)

description.description: Form, e.g. Social Security offset starting at age 62

ipsLocation.description: Where documentation is located in IPS (required if q2 is yes)

q1.description: Does the plan provide non-level benefits or other forms that may require future adjustments?

q2.description: Are any participants receiving benefits in those forms? (required if q1 is yes)

spectrumConfirmed.description: Has EBLS/field office entered end-dates in Spectrum? (yes if q2 is yes)

answer.description: Does the plan contain offsets to be applied to benefits?

description.description: Describe the offset(s) and give guidance for benefit administration (required if yes)

ipsNumber.description: Successor Plan Determination IPS number (required if outcome is 6.3)

isSuccessor.description: Is the plan a successor to the prior plan? (required if outcome is 6.3)

outcome.description: 6.1 earlier plan not identified; 6.2 determination not needed; 6.3 results of determination

screening.description: Table 6 screening questions (required if outcome is 6.2 or 6.3)

mgb.description: Would the determination affect the MGB limitation?

pc3.description: Would the determination affect allocation of assets to PC3?

phaseInMajority.description: Would the determination affect phase-in for a majority owner (NOIT/NOD on or after 1/1/2006)?

phaseInNonOwner.description: Would the determination affect phase-in for a participant who is not a substantial or majority owner?

phaseInSubstantial.description: Would the determination affect phase-in for a substantial owner (NOIT/NOD before 1/1/2006)?

section436g.description: Would the determination affect the §436(g) exception (plan in effect less than 5 plan years)?

estimatedAssets.description: Estimated asset figure from the auditor, dollars (number) or null

pc3Done.description: Was the PC3 analysis performed? (relevant if q2 is yes)

q1.description: Are there participants in pay status subject to benefit adjustments?

q2.description: Are any retired or eligible to retire on DOPT-3 (BPD-3 for bankruptcy plans)? (required if q1 is yes)

aggregateLimit.description: Participants affected by the Aggregate Limit, or note that the information is not yet available

disabled.description: Persons with disabilities recognized by the plan

mgbExceeds.description: Pre-DOPT retirees whose monthly benefit exceeds their MGB

phaseInAffected.description: Participants affected by the phase-in limitation

shouldReduce.description: Retirees who attained an age where a change should have been implemented but was not

supplements.description: Retirees receiving supplements as of DOPT

ucebPhaseIn.description: Retirees receiving supplements subject to UCEB phase-in

dataBasis.description: Estimated guaranteed benefits calculated based on ___ data (e.g. SPECTRUM participant data as of DOPT)

dataSource.description: Data obtained from ___ (e.g. TRMD SPECTRUM download)

narrative.description: Whether supplements, in whole or in part, are guaranteeable under the accrued-at-normal limit, and how the MGB affects participants

tables.description: Tables 1-6 participant rows (SSN + name exactly as in the participant data)

supplementEnds.description: Date supplement ends, YYYY-MM-DD or null

t2.description: Table 2: benefits that should have been reduced

reduceDate.description: Date benefit should be reduced, YYYY-MM-DD or null

c91.description: 9.1 Mandatory or Voluntary Employee Contributions identified

c93.description: 9.3 Benefits estimated impacted by PBGC limitations

c93ab.description: 9.3 A: in-pay participants impacted; B: no in-pay impacted but deferred participants could be

c94.description: 9.4 Majority Owner identified and plan in effect less than 10 years

c95.description: 9.5 Other limitations, liabilities valued in PC6

conclusion.description: Actuary's chosen conclusion. Null = use the app's computed suggestion: impacted if (any of 9.1-9.4) OR (9.5 AND Funded GL Ratio >= 80%); else not impacted.

fundedGlRatio.description: Funded GL Ratio from the most recent NRAD Pension Information Profile, percent (required if 9.5 applies)
